antarctic_expeditions.leader: Dr. Syed Zahoor Qasim (Secretary, Department of Environment / Ocean Development)
antarctic_expeditions.key_milestones: First Indian landing on Antarctica (Queen Maud Land). Set up unmanned weather shelter 'Dakshin Gangotri' base camp. Hoisted Indian flag on the White Continent.

antarctic_expeditions.leader: V. K. Raina (Geological Survey of India)
antarctic_expeditions.key_milestones: Surveyed Schirmacher Oasis rocky plateau for future permanent base. First physiological cold acclimatization experiments conducted.

antarctic_expeditions.leader: Dr. Harsh K. Srivastava (Department of Ocean Development)
antarctic_expeditions.key_milestones: Constructed Dakshin Gangotri base in a record 60 days on the Princess Astrid ice shelf. Left the first 12-member Indian wintering team to overwinter in Antarctica.

antarctic_expeditions.leader: Dr. B. B. Bhattacharya (Indian School of Mines, Dhanbad)
antarctic_expeditions.key_milestones: First relief of the wintering party. Installed permanent magnetic observatory at Dakshin Gangotri.

antarctic_expeditions.leader: M. K. Kaul (Geological Survey of India)
antarctic_expeditions.key_milestones: Extensive geological mapping of Wohlthat Mountains and Humboldt Ridge.

antarctic_expeditions.leader: Dr. R. Sengupta (National Institute of Oceanography)
antarctic_expeditions.key_milestones: Constructed Maitri station on rocky permafrost ground in Schirmacher Oasis to replace Dakshin Gangotri.
Commissioned Maitri as India's main permanent operational base. Decommissioned Dakshin Gangotri as it became buried under snow.
First routine ozonesonde balloon launch series to monitor the spring Antarctic Ozone Hole.
First shallow ice-core drilling on continental shelf (60 m depth) for paleoclimatic temperature reconstruction.
Installed permanent IGS GPS tracking station at Maitri linked to international geodetic network.
Reconnaissance expedition to Larsemann Hills identifying Grovnes Peninsula as site for India's 3rd station.
Erected structural superstructure for Bharati base. Conducted the historic 8-member Indian South Pole Ski Expedition reaching 90°S.
Formal commissioning of Bharati Station on 18 March 2012. Integrated the ISRO Antarctica Ground Station.
Completed the landmark 3,000 km overland traverse from Maitri to Bharati across Princess Elizabeth Land.
40th anniversary expedition. Conducted under zero-infection COVID-19 quarantine protocols via Cape Town.
Permafrost temperature profiling and lake microbial bio-banking; surveys for Maitri-II replacement base.
Modernized meteorological telemetry arrays and site preparation for the state-of-the-art Maitri-II station.

arctic_expeditions.significance: Initial scientific feasibility, biological sampling, and atmospheric aerosol load measurements.
Formal inauguration of Himadri Station on 1 July 2008. Initiated long-term monitoring of Vestre Lovénbreen glacier.
Successful deployment of IndARC, India's maiden multi-sensor subsurface moored observatory at 192 m water depth.
Flag-off of India's maiden Winter Arctic Scientific Expedition, stationing Indian scientists through polar night.

southern_ocean_expeditions.significance: Pilot multidisciplinary Southern Ocean voyage studying physical, chemical, and biological oceanography from 40°S to 60°S.
Carbon sequestration, iron limitation, and coccolithophore dynamics in the Sub-Antarctic Front.
High-resolution hydrography, air-sea CO2 flux, and microplastic quantification in the Southern Ocean.
